title: Predict a number with regression
summary: Regression predicts a number instead of a class. LinearRegression fits a straight-line relationship to the examples.
introduction: Regression predicts a number instead of a class. LinearRegression fits a straight-line relationship to the examples. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain predict a number with regression
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Regression predicts a number instead of a class. LinearRegression fits a straight-line relationship to the examples.

blocks.code:
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
model = LinearRegression().fit([[1], [2], [3]], [2, 4, 6])
print(round(float(model.predict([[4]])[0]), 2))
blocks.title: Predict a number with regression

blocks.text: The output is 8.0. The training examples follow the exact rule output = 2 times input.
